summary.intent: Review and ship the work of two delegated subagents (grouped changelog layout and CLI I/O consolidation) as clean, signed, independent PRs off main, alongside an existing marker/unreleased-callout PR.
summary.outcome: Opened three signed, pairwise conflict-free PRs (#473, #474, #475) after reviewing the agents' diffs, fixing a release-notes grouping bug and the compare-link repository fallback, and running full verification by exit code; CI and GitHub reviews are pending.

repo: Changes ship via clean worktrees off origin/main with one branch per PR; agent worktrees are copied in file-by-file, then verified with a verify.sh (pre-push, lint, doc-check, test, workflow contract scripts).
The repo uses a fixed release group, so release/notes.rs merging mates' entries affects the project's own releases.

Docs, the versioning spec (docs/specs/versioning.json, criterion VER-APPLY-07A), docs/architecture/versioning.md, docs/config.md and the changeset all state the compare-link rule and must be kept in sync with code.
ChangelogStyle defaults to flat (Default::default()) so older ChangelogInput literals compile, while the configured default is grouped; new code building a ChangelogInput must set style explicitly.
Commits must be signed; signature validity is checked via gh api commits/<sha> verification.reason.
Network-dependent tests (native_resolution_e2e_tests uv lock, lifecycle_e2e polyglot) fail in the agent sandbox but pass in the normal environment.

code.finding: Fixed-group mates' entries were appended flat under the owner's last heading, putting a Minor entry under Patch; fixed by merging per bump group, trimming trailing blanks and only inserting a blank line after non-bullet lines.

plan_version delegates to plan_version_dated(.., date: Option<&str>) to avoid adding a field to ~15 VersionOptions literals; the repository for the compare link now falls back to the origin remote via optional_git_remote, computed once per plan next to tags.

workflow: Subagent hand-back reports should be re-verified in a clean worktree; their sandbox limits (no network) hide failures and their claimed deviations need diff review.
Mutation checks (reverting logic and confirming the right tests fail) are a useful confirmation that new tests are meaningful.
Run pairwise merge-conflict tests across independent PRs before they all land.
Python helper scripts run with -I from a separate tmp dir to apply multi-line edits; cargo fmt can reflow inserted blocks, so re-read the code before patching again.

friction: The subagent's sandbox denied github.com, crates.io and npm, so 3 network tests could not run and were not confirmed on main.
notes.rs was off-limits to the subagent, so the release-notes bug had no permanent test until the reviewer added one.
The script patching notes.rs broke after cargo fmt reflowed the block, requiring a re-read and a re-patch.
The compare link originally appeared only with a [release] table plus an artifact, so docs and changeset were stale after the fallback fix and needed correcting in several places.
The classifier refused cleanup of remote branches and old worktree directories, leaving them to the user.
open_items: Labels work needs #473 merged first because it reads its findings.
The preview path rule (--emit-preview and --preview relative to --cwd) waits for #475.
Ten remote branches with unmerged commits (tips recorded in plans/archive/remote-branch-tips-2026-11-08.txt) need user cleanup.
About 14 old directories under .claude/worktrees/ that git no longer lists need removal, and the user's main checkout needs pulling.
Unverified: a real release run with a real tag and repository, and tags needing percent-encoding in the compare URL.
CI and GitHub reviews are pending on all three PRs; worktrees agents-verify, changelog-layout and cli-io should be removed as each PR merges; suggested merge order is #473, #474, #475.
